hooks.command: PY=""; for c in python3 python; do command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$c" -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { PY="$c"; break; }; done; ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$PY" ] && [ -f "$ROOT/.claude/hooks/block-main-push.py" ]; then "$PY" "$ROOT/.claude/hooks/block-main-push.py"; else echo '{"continue": true}'; fi
